newsitem.title: USA: Fieldcrest Cannon sells blanket inventory.
newsitem.headline: Fieldcrest Cannon sells blanket inventory.

text.p: Fieldcrest Cannon Inc said on Monday it completed the sale of certain Blanket Division inventories and equipment to Pillowtex Corp.
The transaction includes a long-term license agreement under which Pillowtex will sell blankets, throws, pillows and mattress pads with Fieldcrest Cannon's brands and other marks.
The purchase price of about $30 million was received in cash and is subject to adjustment for changes in inventory levels from June 30 to November 18.
Fieldcrest Cannon will initially use the proceeds to repay borrowings under its revolving credit facility.
